title: Pooja Logistics IPO Details
intro:
Pooja Logistics IPO is a book build issue of ₹44.23 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 38.46 lakh shares of ₹44.23 crore.

Pooja Logistics IPO opens for subscription on Sep 23, 2026 and closes on Sep 25, 2026. The allotment for the Pooja Logistics IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 28, 2026. Pooja Logistics IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 30, 2026.

Pooja Logistics IPO is set issue price band at ₹109 to ₹115 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,76,000 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹4,14,000.

Share India Capital Services Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company are Prabhat Financial Services Ltd. , Share India Securities Ltd.

Refer to Pooja Logistics IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2011, Pooja Logistics Ltd. is engaged in providing temperature-controlled logistics services for the transportation of perishable goods across India through refrigerated trucks (“reefers”). The company offers cold chain logistics services to a range of industries. Their in-house fleet as on March 31, 2026 comprises over 424 GPS-enabled vehicles dedicated to the transportation of temperature-sensitive goods.

The company cater to clients operating in the confectionery, dairy and dairy products, quick-service restaurants (QSRs), pharmaceuticals, and e-commerce sectors. We transport temperature-sensitive consignments while maintaining operational systems designed to maintain compliance with applicable standards.
As on July 31, 2026, the company has total employed around 101 employees.
strengths: Organizational stability along with Promoter’s experience

faqs.question: How to apply in Pooja Logistics IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Pooja Logistics IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Pooja Logistics IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Pooja Logistics IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Pooja Logistics IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Pooja Logistics IPO?
faqs.answer: Pooja Logistics IPO lot size is 1200 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,76,000 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Pooja Logistics IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Pooja Logistics IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Pooja Logistics IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Pooja Logistics IPO will be done on Monday, September 28, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Tue, Sep 29, 2026 . Check the Pooja Logistics IPO allotment status .

faqs.answer: The Pooja Logistics IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Wed, Sep 30, 2026 .
